description.zh: 弱酸在水里只有一部分解离成 H⁺ 和 A⁻，Ka 越大解离的比例越高；加水稀释反而让解离比例上升，加入 A⁻（共同离子）则把平衡推回去。
description.en: A weak acid splits only partly into H⁺ and A⁻ in water, and the larger Ka is, the larger that share; diluting it actually raises the share that dissociates, while adding A⁻ (a common ion) pushes the balance back.

en: why is acetic acid a weak acid
dilution raises the degree of dissociation

label.zh: pH 读的是平衡时的 H⁺
label.en: pH reads the H⁺ left at equilibrium

reason.zh: pH 标度把 [H⁺] 取负对数；弱酸只放出一部分 H⁺，所以同浓度的弱酸 pH 比强酸高，要先由 Ka 算出平衡时的 [H⁺] 才能读 pH。
reason.en: The pH scale is −log of [H⁺]; a weak acid releases only part of its H⁺, so at the same concentration its pH is higher than a strong acid’s, and [H⁺] must first be found from Ka.
